They are intimidating at first. When I opened my first machine I let out a nervous chuckle and thought "Oh crap, that's a lot of stuff going on there". But then after you've been in there you realize it isn't that bad. It's like any machine. Everything has a path and the path has to work. I'm mostly dealing with solid state machines, so everything is triggered by the MPU boards. I can't wait until I get under the hood of an electro-mechanical. Those look crazy.

I'm not a pro at it yet. Still learning new things everyday. Its fun though.
